_note: #953: the Catalyst Shard recipe for native Cartographer maps (type cmap). PD2's own rows name its t1me-t3me maps; these two rows do the same for cmap: a normal map is refused (op 30), any other quality gets the isolated force-event marker, stat map_force_event on layer 1 through the new property map-force-event-l (func 24 puts the mod's param on the stat's layer; PD2's func-1 property leaves it on layer 0, where Cartographer reads it as a player buff; docs/event-link.md). Same ingredients and eligibility as PD2's rows 1951-1956.
